parameters.query:
UPDATE contacts
SET email_logs = COALESCE(email_logs, '[]'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object(
    'id', $4::text,
    'type', 'sent',
    'subject', $1::text,
    'message', $2::text,
    'sent_at', NOW(),
    'is_read', true,
    'opened_at', NULL)
WHERE id = $3
RETURNING email_logs;

UPDATE contacts
SET email_logs = COALESCE(email_logs, '[]'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object(
    'id', $5::text,
    'type', 'sent',
    'subject', $1::text,
    'message', $2::text,
    'sent_at', NOW(),
    'is_read', true,
    'opened_at', NULL,
    'attachments', $3::jsonb
)::jsonb
WHERE id = $4
RETURNING email_logs;
SELECT unsubscribe_token FROM contacts WHERE id = $1;

SELECT c.id, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.email, c.phone, c.job_title, c.lead_status, c.lead_source,
  c.birthdate, c.city, c.state, c.zip_code, c.country, c.created_at, c.updated_at, c.unsubscribe_token, c.timezone,
  comp.id AS company_id, comp.name AS company_name, comp.industry, comp.website,
  comp.street_address AS company_street_address, comp.city AS company_city, comp.state AS company_state,
  comp.zip_code AS company_zip_code, comp.country AS company_country, comp.phone AS company_phone,
  ow.id AS owner_user_id, ow.name AS owner_name, ow.email AS owner_email, ow.phone AS owner_phone
FROM contacts c
LEFT JOIN companies comp ON comp.id = c.account_id
LEFT JOIN users ow ON ow.id = c.owner_id
WHERE c.id = $1;

parameters.query:
SELECT o.id, o.name, o.deal_value, o.status, o.probability, o.expected_close, o.source,
  o.pipeline_id, o.stage_id, o.created_at, o.updated_at,
  pl.name AS pipeline_name
FROM opportunities o
LEFT JOIN pipelines pl ON pl.id = o.pipeline_id
WHERE o.contact_id = $1 AND o.is_archived = false
ORDER BY (o.status = 'Open') DESC, o.updated_at DESC
LIMIT 1;

nodes.name: Dynamic Fields: Pipeline
nodes.notes: Most relevant deal for this contact — prefers an Open one, falls back to the most recently updated. Read-only, not consumed anywhere yet.

nodes.notes: The stage of whichever deal 'Dynamic Fields: Pipeline' resolved above. Read-only, not consumed anywhere yet.

parameters.query:
SELECT a.id, a.type, a.subject, a.due_at, a.end_at, a.location, a.body AS notes, a.is_completed,
  u.name AS assigned_user_name
FROM activities a
LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = a.user_id
WHERE a.contact_id = $1
ORDER BY (a.due_at > now()) DESC, a.due_at DESC
LIMIT 1;
